games.title: CroMagRally
games.summary: CroMag Rally port for OpenDingux. Runs at about 10-25 FPS average. This is my first release using gl4es by ptitseb.

games.title: Death Rally
games.summary: Runs decent but could be made to run better with SDL 1.2 instead of 2.0. Based on the RE version.

games.title: Froggo's Adventure
games.summary: Runs at 10-20 FPS. My first python/pygame that i ported. Performance is not great and porting python games on low end hardware is very challenging. There's a reason why only Visual novels use python for games... pygame is also a load of crap (no offense) and they still don't offer a way to use GPU-accelerated textures, making it a worse mess than it needs to be.

games.title: Heboris
games.summary: Port for OpenDingux. Runs smoothly, i like this game personally. This was based upon the SDL 1.2 version for best performance on low end hardware.

games.title: Hexahop
games.summary: Port for OpenDingux. Runs smoothly. I ported this fun game a while back for the older firmware but it wasn't running great as it was rendering to another buffer, making it wasteful and slowing it down to a crawl. This is now fixed in the new port.

games.title: Overheated
games.summary: Runs at 60 FPS. Great game by BrokenTestType ! The OpenDingux port was not very challenging to do but the Dreamcast port that i did for it was ! Maybe someday i will port it to SDL2 and release it on itch.io...

games.title: Puckman Arena
games.summary: Runs at about 6-10 FPS average. This game targets OpenGL 1.1 so gl4es is used for this game.

games.title: Super Mario War v2 beta
games.summary: Runs at 60 FPS. This one is a classic and very fun to play, even when playing alone.

games.title: WLAOL
games.summary: Port for OpenDingux. Runs OK.

games.title: Anarch
games.summary: Original game by drummyfish, doom-like FPS where you must defeat capitalism.

games.title: Homophobic CornFlakes
games.summary: Short game about two angels had a fight but one wins over the other and decides to punish him in a kinky way. Disclaimer : All Characters 18+, author does not condone real world violence.

games.title: Crafti
games.summary: Minecraft clone originally made for the TI nspire by Vogtinator. I ported it to other platforms. Dreamcast got quite a bit of coverage back then.

games.title: Crazy Bird
games.summary: My take on Flappy bird for the atari 2600. Programmed in Batari Basic.

games.title: Deathtrap
games.summary: Sonic & Mario are both in Hell but they want to escape, don't let them !

games.title: Ganbare Natsuki-san
games.summary: Dreamcast port of a game by Alpha Base (japanese developer) originally for Windows and Xbox 360.

games.title: Helicopters
games.summary: 3DO port of .GEARS's Swing Copters for Mobile phones.

games.title: Hide the Baby
games.summary: Original game by Nick Weihs, a game about a single mom in china trying to hide her "extra" baby.

games.title: Sonic and the Alien Invasion
games.summary: An unfinished Adventure game made with RPG Maker 95. Sonic must face aliens from outer-space ! Note : Set compatibility mode to Windows XP if possible.

games.title: SRB2 32X : Doom Edition
games.summary: An attempt at adapting SRB2 Haloween levels (+ extras) for the 32X

games.title: Sonic RPG Console
games.summary: A very simple text-based RPG where you fight an opponent. It's very old and i released it for a bunch of platforms back then...

games.title: Blaze Doom Adventure
games.summary:
Traverse through 15 levels, from Sonic Zones to the Mushroom Kingdom!

You play as Blaze the Cat, who is unexpectedly approached by an older Doctor Eggman Nega claiming to be from an alternate future timeline.

In his future, kingdoms have collapsed into hostile wastelands, dimensions bleed into one another, and chaos spreads unchecked.

Nega claims there is only one way to stop this future:

Blaze must travel across fractured worlds and create a time paradox strong enough to destabilize the doomed timeline and restore balance.

Armed with strange weapons provided by Nega—and unsure whether she can truly trust him—Blaze begins her adventure.

games.title: Where's Derpy
games.summary: Find Derpy on the images !

games.title: Disgrace to Blabla
games.summary: You are Sonic and you go around with a bazooka while saving hostages. Note that this was made when my English was still very poor so i suggest you ignore the readme and just play the game.

games.title: Cascade FX
games.summary: A Tetris clone with 3D software renderer for the standard NEC PC-FX. It has a training mode and an Arcade mode, with singing tracks.

games.title: Evil australians
games.summary: The Australian government has cloned your DNA and built an army to oppose you. A run'n gun arena platformer game. Jump, shoot at the enemies and complete the levels !

games.title: Blocks 3D
games.summary: Spinoff to Cascade FX. It's a 3D Tetris-clone, with puzzles in 3D space ! Rotate the camera view with mouse, and control with WASD and Cursor keys.

games.title: Shattered Decks
games.summary: Shattered Decks is a single-player card battler with a compact 3D tactical board, animated card reveals, a 40-card deck structure, 5-card hands, direct attacks, monster battles, support cards, fusions, equip bonuses, and story-driven opponents.

games.title: SMW Unlicensed
games.summary: An unofficial port i made based on the disassembly of the original game. This was a 1994-1996 Megadrive game made by Gamtek (Taiwan). I have adapted and arranged the game for NEC PC-FX.

games.title: Doom for PC-FX
games.summary: A (challenging) port of Doom for the NEC PC-FX. Includes all of the shareware levels.
